div.head: Af 9.2
div.ab: Geo wæs goldðeofe ⁊ stodðeofe ⁊ beoþeofe, ⁊ monegu witu maran ðonne oþru; nu sint eall gelic buton monþeofe: CXX scll'.
Geo wæs goldðeofe ⁊ stodðeofe ⁊ beoðeofe, ⁊ manig witu maran ðonne oþru; nu sint eal gelic buton manðeofe: CXX scill’.
Aliquando fuit de eo qui aurum furabatur uel equas siluestres uel apes, et multe wite maiores quam alie. Nunc sunt omnes pares preter manþeofe (qui hominem furatur): centum uiginti sol.
Geo wæs goldðeofe ⁊ stódðeofe ⁊ beoðeofe, ⁊ manig witu maran ðonne oþru; nu sint eal gelic buton manðeofe: CXX scill.
Earlier the fines for a gold-thief and a stud-thief and a bee-thief and many fines were greater than others; now all are alike except theft of a person:120 shillings.
Formerly the fines to be paid by those who stole gold and horses and bees, and many other fines, were greater than the rest. Now all fines, with the exception of that for stealing men—120 shillings.

Formerly, [the fine] for the stealer of gold, the stealer of stud-horses, the stealer of bees, and many fines, were greater than others; now all are alike, except for the stealer of a man: 120 shillings.
Einst war dem Golddiebe und Gestütsdiebe und Bienendiebe [je eine Strafe], und viele [Missethaten hatten] Strafgelder grösser als andere; jetzt sind alle gleich, ausser Menschendieb: 120 Schill.

Formerly there was [a separate fine] for the gold-thief and the stud-thief and the bee-thief, and many [offences had] fines greater than others; now all are equal, except the man-thief: 120 shillings.
